messages.subject: Base Methylation to Gene Methylation?
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I've been using MethylKit to process bismarkCytosine BED files with the goal of detecting differentially methylated genes between two groups of samples. I've been able to read in the files and get differentially methylated bases and their associated TSS with the following sequence of commands:
methRead()
unite()
calculateDiffMeth()
getMethylDiff()
Genomation: annotateWithGeneParts()
Genomation: getAssociationWithTSS()
I was wondering if there's a way to "integrate" the numerous differentially methylated bases for each gene region/TSS and get a singular value of differential methylation for entire regions? Thanks!

-Nhan

You can check the methods in this paper: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3622633/
However, the package mentioned in the paper is no longer on CRAN, but the paper has ideas on how to combine DMCs for a given region and calculate a joint p-value. Check the section titled "Statistical significance calculation for DMRs"

Altuna
